newsitem.title: CHINA: China Zhenhai processes 1.1 mln T oil.
newsitem.headline: China Zhenhai processes 1.1 mln T oil.

text.p: Zhenhai Refining and Chemical Co Ltd processed a record 1.1 million tonnes of crude oil in the first two months of this year, a company official said on Tuesday.
The company also produced 103,000 tonnes of high-quality fertiliser in the period, the official said by telephone from corporate headquarters in Zhenhai in the eastern province of Zhejiang.
The company, which has shares listed in Hong Kong, owns and operates a refinery complex in Zhenhai, south of Shanghai.
Zhenhai aims to boost earnings by 70 million yuan ($8.4 million) in 1997 by refining more high quality crude oil from the Middle East, the China Chemical Industry News said on Tuesday.
The company earned 850 million yuan last year.
The company expects to generate additional profits this year from a refining expansion project that added annual capacity of 8.0 million tonnes. It gave no further details.
